entry.title: Building Infrastructure for Handling Millions of Bitcoin UTXOs at Scale
entry.summary:
The Challenge: Account Model vs UTXO Model
If you've ever designed a custodian solution for Ethereum, you might have found it surprisingly straightforward. Creating wallets from mnemonics, managing deposits and withdrawals, and even implementing multisig solutions using Safe (onchain) or MPC/TSS (offchain) are relatively simple tasks. This ease stems from Ethereum's account model, which treats balances as fungible assets in individual accounts. Bitcoin, however, operates fundamentally differently due to its UTXO (Unspent Transaction Output) architecture. This creates unique challenges for custodians managing Bitcoin at scale.
